items.title: 2.7.1 Working with Modules in Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of working with modules (PDF 55-56).

blocks.text: Python mein module bas ek file hai jis mein Python code ho, jaise functions, variables aur classes, jinhein program ke mukhtalif hisson mein dobara istemal kiya ja sake. Module banana aasan hai: code ek file mein likh kar .py extension ke saath save kar dein. Neeche module aur main function ke saath us ka istemal hai.
Qadam 1: greetings.py naam ki module file banayein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab function ka naam say_As-Salaam-Alaikum likhti hai. Python mein naam mein sirf letters, digits aur underscore aa sakte hain; hyphen (-) minus ka nishan hai, is liye SyntaxError aata hai. Yahan sahi naam say_salaam istemal hua hai, dono files mein.
Wazahat: is se greetings naam ka module banta hai jis mein ek salaam wala function hai.
Qadam 2: main.py naam ki doosri file banayein jo is module ko istemal kare. Is mein main function hoga jahan se program shuru hota hai:

# main.py
import greetings
def main () :
    message = greetings.say_salaam()
    print(message)
if __name__ == "__main__": main ()
# Output : As - Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab main.py mein bhi greetings.say_As- Salaam-Alaikum() bulati hai; yeh bhi ghalat naam hai. Sahi: greetings.say_salaam().

Wazahat: python main.py chalane par Python greetings module import karti hai, us ka function bulati hai aur paighaam print karti hai: "As - Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!". Is tarah greetings module app ke doosre hisson mein bhi istemal ho sakta hai, aur main function saaf batata hai ke program kahan se shuru hota hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Modules ke saath main function istemal karne se code munazzam rehta hai aur sambhalna aasan hota hai. Program ka shuru hone ka nuqta hamesha main function se tay karein, aur code ke alag hisse alag modules mein rakhein.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Python ki standard library saikron modules par mushtamil hai jo aam kaam karte hain, jaise dates ke saath kaam, random adad banana ya files parhna.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
calculator.py naam ka module banayein jis mein do functions hon:
1. add(a, b): do adad ka jor wapas kare.
2. subtract(a, b): do adad ka farq wapas kare.
Phir main.py likhein jo calculator import kare aur:
1. 15 aur 8 ka jor print kare.
2. 25 mein se 10 ghata kar print kare.
main.py chala kar dekhein ke output sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: calculator.py mein add(a, b) aur subtract(a, b) likhein aur main.py mein 15 + 8 aur 25 - 10 print karein.
blocks.explanation: calculator.py: def add(a, b): return a + b aur def subtract(a, b): return a - b. main.py: import calculator; print(calculator.add(15, 8)) se 23; print(calculator.subtract(25, 10)) se 15. python main.py se chalayein.

blocks.prompt: temperature_converter.py module banayein jis mein celsius_to_fahrenheit(c) aur fahrenheit_to_celsius(f) hon, aur main.py se 25 C aur 77 F badlein (long question 7).
blocks.explanation: temperature_converter.py mein: def celsius_to_fahrenheit(c): return 9 / 5 * c + 32 aur def fahrenheit_to_celsius(f): return 5 / 9 * (f - 32). main.py mein: import temperature_converter as tc; print(tc.celsius_to_fahrenheit(25)) se 77.0 aur print(tc.fahrenheit_to_celsius(77)) se 25.0.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Long question 7 mein kitab formulas F = | x C + 32 aur C = | x (F - 32) chhapti hai; '|' ki jagah kasar (fraction) honi chahiye. Sahi formulas: F = 9/5 x C + 32 aur C = 5/9 x (F - 32). Is se 25 °C = 77 °F aur 77 °F = 25 °C banta hai.

items: Function ke naam mein hyphen nahi chalta (say_salaam theek hai).
